meta.review_notes: Re-analyzed 2026-05-16 with strict legal-safe rules. Policy silent on camera/microphone, phone contacts/address book, and local file access for mobile; these categories marked unknown. Several red flags reworded to match exact policy text. No 'sell' or 'cross-app tracking' claims made without explicit text.

app.name: Perplexity - AI Search & Chat
app.description: AI-powered search and chat that delivers direct answers with cited sources.

verdict.one_liner: AI search that automatically collects usage data and shares it with advertising partners and data enrichment companies.
verdict.summary: Perplexity offers AI search, but its privacy policy states that it automatically collects broad Usage Data including device identifiers, approximate location, and clickstream data. It discloses sharing information with advertising partners, business partners, and service providers, and receives data from consumer marketing databases to customize advertising and marketing. While it provides account deletion and opt-out options for AI training, the broad tracking and third-party sharing raise privacy concerns.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Perplexity shares data with advertising partners and data enrichment companies, and automatically collects device identifiers and approximate location. If you value privacy, consider using it without syncing personal email accounts or creating an account.

red.title: Data shared with advertising partners and data enrichment companies
red.plain_english: Perplexity states that it may disclose your information to Advertising Partners and that it receives information from consumer marketing databases or other data enrichment companies to customize advertising and marketing.

red.title: Email sync may access the content of your emails
red.plain_english: If you choose to sync your email account, Perplexity states that it will have access to your contacts and the content of your email messages and calendar appointments.

red.title: Uses tracking technologies for analytics and advertising
red.plain_english: Perplexity states that it and certain third parties automatically collect information about your interactions through cookies, pixels, tags, and other tracking technologies, and that it receives data from enrichment companies to customize advertising and marketing.

red.title: Collects unique device identifiers and IP address
red.plain_english: Perplexity states that it automatically collects device information including device type, operating system, unique device identifier, and IP address.

red.title: Data may be transferred to the United States
red.plain_english: Perplexity states that the personal information it collects will be transferred to, stored at, or processed in countries including the United States.

green.title: Email content not used for AI training
green.plain_english: Perplexity states that it does not use or disclose Email Service Information to create, train, improve, or fine-tune AI models.

green.title: Account deletion available
green.plain_english: Perplexity states that you can delete your account and that it aims to delete your personal information from its servers within 30 days.

green.title: Can opt out of AI improvement data
green.plain_english: Perplexity states that you may opt out of information collection for AI, which would prohibit it from using your search information to improve its AI models.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention whether the app accesses your camera or microphone.
categories.detail: The privacy policy does not explicitly address camera or microphone access for the mobile application.
concerns: Policy does not address camera or microphone usage

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Perplexity states that it automatically collects approximate location information, and that precise geolocation may be collected from the mobile application with your consent.
categories.detail: The privacy policy lists 'Location information, such as approximate location' as part of automatically collected Usage Data. It also notes that precise geolocation information may be collected from the mobile application when you consent.
categories.policy_excerpt: Location information, such as approximate location.
concerns: Approximate location collected automatically
Precise geolocation collected on mobile with consent

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention whether the app accesses your phone's contacts or address book.
categories.detail: The policy mentions contacts in the context of synced email accounts, but does not explicitly address phonebook or address book access for the mobile application.
concerns: Policy does not explicitly address phone contacts or address book access

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention whether the app accesses files or storage on your device.
categories.detail: The policy mentions content you input or upload to the Services, but does not explicitly address local file or photo library access for the mobile application.
concerns: Policy does not address storage or file access

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Perplexity states that it may disclose your information to third parties including advertising partners, business partners, service providers, and professional advisors, and may share data during corporate transactions.
categories.detail: The privacy policy lists extensive third-party sharing: Company Group, Service Providers, Business Partners, Other Third Parties, Advertising Partners, Professional Advisors, and Business Transactions. It also states that Perplexity receives information from consumer marketing databases and data enrichment companies.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may disclose your information to third parties subject to this Privacy Policy, including the following categories of third parties: Advertising Partners
concerns: Broad sharing with advertising partners and data enrichment companies
Data may be shared during corporate transactions

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Perplexity states that it collects basic contact details and account information such as name, email, and password to provide the Services.
categories.detail: The policy collects Contact Information (name, address, phone number, email) and Account Information (name, username, email, password). It also receives information from data enrichment companies to customize advertising and marketing, but does not explicitly state that your account identity is linked to those advertising profiles.
categories.policy_excerpt: Basic contact details, such as name, address, phone number, and email ('Contact Information').
concerns: Data enrichment companies receive information for marketing customization
Identity data required to create an account

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Perplexity states that it and certain third parties automatically collect information about your interactions using cookies, pixels, tags, and other tracking technologies, and that it receives information from data enrichment companies to customize advertising and marketing.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly describes Tracking Technologies (cookies, pixels, tags) used to collect Usage Data including device info, location, clickstream, and ad impressions. It also states that Perplexity receives information from consumer marketing databases or data enrichment companies to customize advertising and marketing.
categories.policy_excerpt: We and certain third parties also automatically collect certain information about your interaction with the Services ('Usage Data') through the use of cookies, pixels, tags and other tracking technologies ('Tracking Technologies').
concerns: Tracking technologies collect interaction data automatically
Data from enrichment companies used for marketing customization

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Perplexity states that children under 13 are not permitted to use the Services and that it does not knowingly collect personal information about children.
categories.detail: The policy states children under 13 are not permitted and that Perplexity does not knowingly collect personal information about children. It requires parental consent for users above 13 but below the age of consent. No detailed enforcement mechanism is described.
categories.policy_excerpt: Children under the age of 13 are not permitted to use the Services, and we do not seek or knowingly collect any personal information about children
concerns: Age restriction stated but enforcement mechanism not described

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Perplexity states that it automatically collects network and interaction information such as IP address, browser type, log data, and clickstream data.
categories.detail: Usage Data includes IP address, browser type, log data, date and time stamps, clickstream data, interactions with marketing emails, and ad impressions. This is collected automatically.
categories.policy_excerpt: Other information regarding your interaction with the Services, such as browser type, log data, date and time stamps, clickstream data, interactions with marketing emails, and ad impressions.
concerns: IP address and clickstream data collected automatically

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Perplexity states that it collects device information including device type, operating system, unique device identifier, and IP address as part of Usage Data.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly lists 'Device information, such as device type, operating system, unique device identifier, and internet protocol (IP) address' as automatically collected Usage Data. This data is used to tailor features, run analytics, and measure user interaction, and may be used by third parties for such purposes.
categories.policy_excerpt: Device information, such as device type, operating system, unique device identifier, and internet protocol (IP) address.
concerns: Unique device identifiers collected automatically
Device data shared with third-party analytics providers

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Perplexity states that if you opt in to Perplexity Health, you may choose to provide health information. This is completely optional.
categories.detail: The policy states that health information is collected only when you voluntarily consent to opt in to Perplexity Health. Under the CCPA section, it also notes that health, genetic, and biometric information may be collected if you consent to use Perplexity Health and upload data.
categories.policy_excerpt: Where available in your location, any health information you choose to provide. We use this information when you voluntarily consent to opt in to Perplexity Health.
concerns: Health data collected only on opt-in basis
Biometric information mentioned under CCPA for Perplexity Health

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Perplexity states that payment information is collected using a third-party payment processor when you make a purchase.
categories.detail: Payment information such as credit or debit card information and billing address is collected using a third-party payment processor. The app does not directly store raw card numbers.
categories.policy_excerpt: Payment information, such as credit or debit card information and billing address, which we collect using a third party payment processor
concerns: Payment data processed by third-party processor

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: Perplexity states that you can delete your account, and it aims to delete your personal information from its servers within 30 days. It also lists access, correction, and portability rights.
categories.detail: Users can delete their account via settings or by contacting support. The policy states it aims to delete personal information within 30 days. GDPR and CCPA rights including access, correction, deletion, and portability are described.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you delete your account, we aim to delete your personal information from our servers within 30 days.
concerns: Deletion is described as an aim, not a guaranteed timeframe

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Perplexity states that it will use reasonable efforts to notify you of material changes, but continued use after an update constitutes acceptance.
categories.detail: The policy states that material changes will be notified via email or posting on the Services, but if you do not agree to updates, you should stop using the Services. Continued use constitutes agreement.
categories.policy_excerpt: If we make material changes to the way in which we use or disclose information we collect, we will use reasonable efforts to notify you
concerns: Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance
